supersession_reason: Pre-training audit rejected the original radius-4 graph travel because uniform-medium maximum error was 9.7-12.4 ms, which is several radians at retained high frequencies. No E1d training was launched under v1.
hypothesis: A constant-graph-debiased eikonal phase carrier will strictly reduce two-seed mean confirmation error on four-family unseen train groups versus identical raw WFP.
single_conceptual_change: phase carrier enabled versus disabled; the v2 carrier subtracts constant-grid directional error and is exact in uniform media

data_access.training_full_truth_use: offline targets and fixed loss denominators only

shared_training.coverage: every fit record and all 64 frequencies exactly once per epoch
shared_training.physical_loss: 64 times coefficient SSE divided by complete record coefficient energy

primary_metric: two-seed mean confirmation physical 64-bin relative L2
failure_signal: Reject and do not expand to 2800 if phase confirmation mean is not strictly lower than raw or any data/boundary/finite gate fails.
conditional_next_step: Only accepted E1d-v2 may trigger all-2800 derived-label generation and final all-train retraining.
rollback: Additive run; preserve v1 travel as rejection evidence and all existing checkpoints.
